scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣耀的殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
请在这里安心休息。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣耀的殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You will now end
your present life and
begin an entirely new life.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
您即将结束
现世的生命，
开始全新的生活。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
There are a few things you must
do before we start. You must
first empty your mind and body.
Honor comes when you abandon
all your selfish desires...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
在开始之前，
有几件事必须完成。
您必须首先清空
身心。
荣耀源于舍弃
一切私欲...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You cannot take anything with you to the next life. Your items, zeny, pets and Pushcart all have to be left behind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
您不能带任何东西
进入来世。您的物品、Zeny、宠物和手推车都必须留下。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
When you are ready
please return to me,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
当您准备好时，
请回来见我，
勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I see you've already
released yourself from
all worldy attachments,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
看来您已经
斩断了所有
世俗的牵绊，
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
That's an admirable attitude for an adventurer such as yourself. Honor comes when you abandon all personal desires for the sake of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
对于像您这样的冒险者来说，这是令人钦佩的态度。为了人类，舍弃一切个人私欲，方能获得荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Hmm... I sense that you have
some lingering attachment or
unfinished business in your
current life. Take care of that,
and bring closure to your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
嗯...我感觉到您
在现世还有
未了的心愿或牵绊。
请处理好它们，
为现世的生活画上句号。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Now, let me remove all
of your present memories...
However, you will be able to
remember the most honorable
moments of this life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
现在，让我抹去
您现世的所有记忆...
不过，您依然能
记得此生最荣耀的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With one,
I will ask the
goddess Urd to remove
all of your present
memories.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
第一，
我将请求
女神乌尔德
抹去您现世的
所有记忆。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With two,
I will ask the
goddess Verdandi to keep
and record the most honorable moments of your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
第二，
我将请求
女神薇丹蒂
保留并记录
您现世生活中
最荣耀的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With three,
I will ask the
goddess Skuld to
guide you to your
next life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
第三，
我将请求
女神丝柯尔德
指引您
前往来世。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
一...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......

[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......
And Three.

[Valkyrie]
Congratulations.
You are now reborn
into a brand new life.
Please take these small gifts
in preparation for your new adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
恭喜。
您已重生，
开始了全新的生活。
请收下这些小小的礼物，
为您新的冒险做准备。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I wish that the release the goddess Urd has granted you proves to be a blessing. I hope that the memories Verdandi has recorded will always honor you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
愿女神乌尔德赐予您的释放成为您的祝福。希望女神薇丹蒂记录下的记忆能永远为您带来荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
And I pray that the new life to which the goddess Skuld will guide you will be even more honorable than your last.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
我也祈祷女神丝柯尔德指引您的新生活，比上一世更加荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣耀的殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Unfortunately, you have not yet been invited here. I ask you to leave immediately. Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔基里]
很遗憾，您尚未收到邀请。请您立即离开。向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I assume you have come here
to read the 'Book of Ymir.'
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施瓦伊希比尔魔法学院的图书馆。
我想您是来阅读《尤米尔之书》的。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, the original copy of the book has been damaged over time. We currently only allow the public to view a copy of the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，原书因年代久远已受损。目前我们只允许公众查阅该书的副本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Also, in order to preserve the original 'Book of Ymir,' we have decided to accept donations from people who wish to read the copy we have provided.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
此外，为了保存《尤米尔之书》的原书，我们决定接受希望阅读我们提供的副本之人的捐赠。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The suggested
donation amount is
1,285,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
建议的捐赠金额为
1,285,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Donate.
scripts.translation: 捐赠

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Thank you, your donation will be used for a good cause. You may
now go in and read the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
谢谢，您的捐赠将用于善事。您现在可以进去阅读这本书了。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, you don't seem to possess enough zeny at the moment. Please check your funds and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很遗憾，您目前的Zeny似乎不足。请检查您的资金，然后再来。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Take your time, and
enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
请慢慢来，
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Once again, thank you for your generous donation. Feel free to read a carbon copy of the 'Book of Ymir' at your leisure.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
再次感谢您的慷慨捐赠。请随意阅读《尤米尔之书》的副本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Here, we have a countless number of books. Please take your time and look around.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施瓦伊希比尔魔法学院的图书馆。
这里有无数的书籍。请慢慢浏览。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...The entrance to the Hall of Honor is open to anyone who has moved forward into their next life. It is there to help heroes decide what they want to do, and can lead them to anywhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...通往英灵殿的大门向所有进入下一世的人敞开。它帮助英雄们决定想要做什么，并能将他们带到这个世界的任何地方。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
In the Hall of Honor, everything is prepared for heroes. It is rumored that any wish that cannot be fulfilled in our reality can be realized in the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
在英灵殿中，一切都为英雄们准备好了。传说，任何在现实中无法实现的愿望，都能在英灵殿中实现。

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止阅读

scripts.text: Continue reading.
scripts.translation: 继续阅读

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
.....
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
.....

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There is a forgotten path which leads to the Hall of Honor, the closest place to the heavens. The ordinary will never discover this place...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
有一条被遗忘的道路通往英灵殿，那是离天堂最近的地方。普通人永远无法发现这个地方...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...Therefore, ancient heroes were
always in anguish, knowing that
eventually, they were mortal and
would pass from this realm...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...因此，古代的英雄们
总是痛苦不堪，因为他们知道
自己终有一死，
终将离开这个世界...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There were no documents,
songs, or remaining folklore that had any information on life after death. However, I recently uncovered an old scroll
about Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
没有任何文献、
歌曲或流传的民间传说
记载了死后的生活。然而，我最近发现了一卷
关于瓦尔基里的古旧卷轴...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Valkyrie...
The legendary
guardian angel.
Angel of Ragnarok.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
瓦尔基里...
传说中的
守护天使。
仙境传说的天使。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Adventurers of great strength
and bravery will be lead by
Valkyrie to Valhalla, the Hall
of Honor. There, they will be
given a new life.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
拥有强大力量和勇气的
冒险者将被瓦尔基里
引导至英灵殿，
荣耀的殿堂。在那里，
他们将获得新的生命。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Reborn, they will live again as
even greater heroes that will
brighten the world. Bodies that
were exhausted will be filled
with energy...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
重生之后，他们将再次以更为伟大的英雄身份降临，照亮这个世界。疲惫的身躯将重新充满能量...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
And their souls will be given abilities with the heart of Ymir. However, the heart of Ymir was totally destroyed and scattered all over the world after the battle for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
他们的灵魂将获得尤米尔之心赋予的力量。然而，在卢恩·米德加兹之战后，尤米尔之心被彻底摧毁，碎片散落到了世界各地。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
I have found a small amount of
Ymir heart pieces over a long
long period of time. But I can't
confirm if the story of Valkyrie
and Valhalla is true just
through scientific tests.
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
经过漫长的岁月，我收集到了少量的尤米尔之心碎片。但我无法仅凭科学测试来证实瓦尔基里和英灵殿的故事是否属实。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
So, I am leaving this record in hope that someone in the future
can confirm that Valkyrie and Valhalla actually exist...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
因此，我留下这份记录，希望未来有人能证实瓦尔基里和英灵殿确实存在...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Let the heroes live new lives
so they can protect the world
from danger. And then...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
让英雄们获得新的生命，去保护世界免受危险。然后...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米尔之书]
...

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
恭喜您。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Please refrain
from touching any
of the exhibitions.
..........
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
请勿触摸任何展品。
..........

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Honorable one,
which place do you wish to go?
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
尊贵的人，
您想去哪里？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰

scripts.text: Comodo
scripts.translation: 克魔岛

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Have a nice trip.
scripts.translation:
[传送员]
祝您旅途愉快。
